regime_context: The detector shows a narrowly-led market: Tech Hardware & Semis is the highest-eligible theme, but the overall rank leader Diversified Miners remains ineligible due to the absolute-trend gate. The trend gate has historically helped control drawdown in Hong Kong, so eligibility is the relevant discipline. Momentum rank-IC ~0, so this is a focus lens, not a return forecast. The macro backdrop is heavy geopolitics/AI-tech headlines with a very high unscheduled-surprise share.
emerging_watch: Watch if Diversified Miners becomes eligible (i.e., its absolute-trend gate turns positive) and its momentum score overtakes Tech Hardware & Semis. If that occurs alongside absorption rising above 0.7, it would suggest a broadening rotation with a new leader. Until then, the theme remains ineligible and the handoff is not confirmed.

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: Tech Hardware & Semis is the leading eligible theme, with a durable uptrend (hurst_tag 'trend') and no crowding. The absolute-trend gate keeps ineligible themes out, making this the strongest valid focus point. However, low breadth (0.167) means leadership is concentrated, raising fragility if the few stocks driving it break down.
theses.dissent: Low breadth means a reversal in one or two large-cap tech hardware names could quickly erase relative gains; the high unscheduled macro surprise share (0.88) also raises event risk, and the gate's risk-control benefit may mean reversion in downside if the trend breaks.

falsifier.text: Tech Hardware & Semis lags the Hang Seng Index by more than 2% over any rolling 10-day window before 2026-08-28.
